description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on resident care and facility success.The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. This is a critical leadership position for an individual committed to excellence in long-term care.This full-time position offers a competitive salary, commensurate with experience. Join a team dedicated to providing high-quality care and achieving outstanding outcomes.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities
Proven track record of successful operational and financial management
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
